No savings percentage in the RSA: there is no field for the mandatory footnote.

## 2. Layout and visual direction

### Hero (1200×630, scales to full-width web)

- **Grid:** copy in the left half, product in the right half. Paper background throughout; no hero photo behind type.
- **Hierarchy (top to bottom):** eyebrow → H1 (Inter Bold 52/58, −1 tracking) → subhead (Regular 20/30) → amber CTA with the price in the button → one-line price detail (14px) → proof line (16px) → footnote (12px, Spruce at 70%).
- **Colour:** Deep Spruce for all type and the device. Signal Amber appears exactly twice — the CTA and the alert state on the device — so the eye lands on the button, then the alert.
- **Imagery:** a straight-on render of Thermalyn Pro on a plain wall. Screen shows the setpoint and today's opening hours. One alert card overlaps the device: "Front door open · 4 min · HVAC running." If photography is preferred: a café at 6:55am, lights on, chairs down, nobody in it. No smiling owners, no staff "fighting" over a dial.
- **Footnote placement:** directly under the proof line, same column, inside the 630px fold. Never in the page footer.

### Meta ad (1080×1080)

- **Background:** Deep Spruce, full bleed. All type in Paper.
- **Top-left (safe zone, 80px margins):** on-image text in Inter Bold ~84px over two lines: "Median site: / 18% less HVAC energy". The "18%" can be Signal Amber.
- **Centre-right:** the device render, screen lit, amber setpoint arc; an amber alert chip offset to the lower right.
- **Bottom strip:** the footnote in Paper at 70% opacity, 26px so it survives mobile compression; Corbel wordmark bottom-right in Paper.
- Text covers under 20% of the image. Headline, primary text and CTA live in Meta's fields, not on the image.

## 4. Note to product marketing

Three changes from the brief.

**Headline.** "Cut your energy bills by 40%" isn't supported. The 40% is HVAC's share of a typical bill, not a saving. The pilot median was an 18% cut in HVAC energy, roughly 7% of the total bill; 41% was one site. We lead with control (which 44 of 48 sites confirmed) and carry the 18% HVAC figure, footnoted, as proof. If you want a 40% line, "HVAC is about 40% of your bill" is honest.

**Price.** $149 is a launch price ending Jan 31, and schedules and alerts need the $8/month subscription, so every price reads "$149 + $8/mo per location" with list price noted.

**Google.** No savings percentage: no room for the required footnote.
